stats.title: 10 Microhabits That Instantly Elevate Your Presence

structure.what_is_said: 'You know that feeling when you see a woman and everything about her just feels expensive. She's not covered in designer labels... there's something about her presence that makes you want to respect her. What if I told you that creating that kind of aura is actually much simpler than you think. It's not about money... It's a few small micro habits... any woman can do this.' Voice starts at 0:00, no music-only intro.

structure.what_is_said: Rushing, fidgeting and reacting instantly read as anxious; moving slightly slower - sitting calmly, walking without hurrying - signals 'I'm not chasing anything'; slowing by 10% steadies breath, voice and presence; 'move like you have time'.

structure.what_is_said: 'Hold eye contact. Then pause. Most people try to prove'
structure.how_it_is_shown: WHITE card '3. Hold Eye Contact, Then Pause'.

structure.what_is_said: Elegant women hold eye contact while others speak and pause a second before responding - 'I'm not reacting, I'm choosing'; stillness reads as self-control; calm in silence signals security; tip: hold eye contact on hi / thank you / nice to meet you, soften the gaze, don't rush to fill space.

structure.what_is_said: 'Slow your speech and finish your thoughts. One of the quickest ways to sound more elegant'
structure.how_it_is_shown: WHITE card '4. Slow Your Speech & Finish Your Thoughts'.

structure.what_is_said: Slow down slightly; nerves make us speed up, ramble and soften; speak slow enough to sound intentional and finish sentences; three swaps (I don't know.../That works for me; Sorry this might sound weird.../I have a thought; I'm probably overthinking this/Here's what I'm thinking); pause in stories; slow voice = steadier, finished sentences = certain, certainty delivered calmly = elegant.

structure.what_is_said: Three swaps: Sorry I'm late -> Thank you for waiting; Sorry to bother you -> Do you have a quick second?; Sorry I'm like this -> Thank you for being patient with me; same warmth without lowering your value.

structure.what_is_said: Clean nails, tidy hair, fresh breath, unwrinkled clothes, unscuffed shoes, a bag that isn't falling apart; not luxury but maintenance; the message is 'I respect myself' and people mirror it.

structure.what_is_said: Elegant women don't over-explain when saying no; kind but clear; three ready sentences (I can't make it, but thank you for inviting me / That doesn't work for me, but I hope it goes well / Let me think about it and get back to you); short, warm, firm, no guilt spiral.

structure.what_is_said: Quiet cheat code: end conversations with something warm and specific (I really enjoyed talking with you; You have such calming energy; That was such a good conversation, I needed that); people don't forget how you made them feel.

structure.what_is_said: 'Do what you said you'd do. Especially with yourself. This is the foundation.'
structure.how_it_is_shown: WHITE card '10. Do What You Said You'd Do'.

structure.what_is_said: A high-value woman trusts herself because she keeps her word; people sense self-distrust (hesitation, inconsistency, over-explaining); follow through in small ways: tidy, walk, stop what drains you; start with one promise a day; presence becomes quieter, stronger, more secure.

tricks: HOOK (Q1): 0:00-0:33.4, 11 full-screen clips, one change every 2-4 s (0:00, 0:03, 0:04.7, 0:06.8, 0:10, 0:13.1, 0:14, 0:17, 0:21, 0:25.2, 0:26.8, 0:30). Each clip is a different stylish woman (street candids, creator reels, one talking head) except the two flower shots. No text in the hook. Voice starts on frame 1; picture fades in from black in ~0.3 s. Title order: fade to white 0:33.4 -> 'In Today's Video.' white script card 0:33.8-0:35.1 -> fade from white -> title overlay 'Episode 18 / 10 Habits of an Elegant Woman' 0:37-0:51.9 while the voice explains what the video gives.

POINT OPEN (Q2): every point opens with a 0.4-0.5 s fade to white, then a plain white card with the numbered title in black script that writes on left to right, held 4.6-4.9 s (cards at 0:58.5, 1:42.8, 2:24.3, 3:17.2, 4:32.0, 5:03.1, 5:29.8, 5:59.5, 6:26.5, 6:58.9). The voice reads the point title (sometimes reworded: card 1 'Invest In Your Signature' vs spoken 'Create your signature'; card 2 'Move Like You Have Time' vs 'Move like you're not chasing anything') and goes straight on into the body while the card is still up. The card leaves with a 0.4 s fade from white into a FULL clip (points 1-6, 8, 9) or a dissolve into cream/caramel (points 7, 10).

POINT CLOSE (Q2): most points end on a summary line shown as text (point 1 quote 1:39, point 4 B&W quote 4:16, point 6 quote 5:25, point 9 quote 6:53) or on a calm full-screen clip, then fade to white. Points 1, 4, 6 and 9 end on a caramel/cream quote card - text card -> white card is a common rhythm.

CLIP LENGTH (Q3): FULL clips mostly 3-5 s (film scenes and interviews 4-9 s); one creator clip is held long when it acts out the point: home-ritual woman 2:15-2:23.9 (8.9 s), Angelina Jolie interview 4:07-4:15.6 (8.6 s), two-friends kitchen reel 6:31-6:37.9 (6.8 s with its own 4 cuts), study reel 7:04-7:10.9 (7 s), Amal Clooney 3:22-3:26 (4.7 s). The get-ready reel at 1:47.8 is held 6 s but cuts every ~1 s inside to show 'moves quickly, fidgets'. Rounded insets usually run 4-9 s with the reel's own cuts every 1-2 s.

ROWS (Q4): three kinds. (a) Full-height row of 3 vertical panels with thin caramel gaps (1:17, 1:34, 1:57, 2:47, 3:01, 5:35, 5:39). (b) Small row of 5 or 3 panels in a centred band with caramel above and below (2:02-2:08, 5:45-5:49). (c) single centre panel on caramel first, then both side panels together (1:16->1:17, 1:54->1:57). Rows of type (a)/(b) build one panel at a time left to right, about 1 per second (1:34-1:35, 2:02-2:05, 2:47-2:48, 3:01-3:02). Panels show DIFFERENT women (different creators, ages, skin tones). In point 7 each panel appears exactly on the listed word: 5:35 'Clean nails', 5:36 'tidy hair', 5:37 'fresh breath', 5:39 'clothes that aren't wrinkled', 5:40 'shoes', 5:42 'a bag'.

SMALL TEXT (Q5): no creator credits, no @handles, no names of celebrities, no product names anywhere. Only small text: 'Episode 18' above the title, 'Check The Description' above the guide name, 'www.classyladyacademy.com' (8:27-8:31), the creator's own kept TikTok caption 'forever craving to reach my highest potential' (7:04-7:10), and the LA Times 'the Envelope' logo left visible (2:52, 7:16).

NAMED WOMEN (Q6): famous women appear but are NEVER named by voice or text: Amal Clooney (0:40-0:42 under the title, 3:22-3:26), Kate Middleton with Prince William (2:41-2:45 engagement interview) and as Princess of Wales (6:08-6:10), Gwyneth Paltrow and Jennifer Lopez (2:52-2:56 and 7:16-7:19), Beyonce on CNN (2:57-3:00), Angelina Jolie interview (4:07-4:15) and in 'The Tourist' (4:52-4:57), Audrey Hepburn in 'Sabrina' B&W (4:16-4:20) and 'Breakfast at Tiffany's' (8:17-8:19), Margot Robbie in 'The Wolf of Wall Street' (6:04-6:07), Jessica Alba (7:11-7:15). Always full-screen video (except the B&W rounded inset), 3-9 s each, used in the 'how to speak / listen / carry yourself' points (3, 4, 5, 8, 10).

DO/DON'T (Q7): never side-by-side, no ticks or crosses. The 'instead of -> try' swaps are shown as two lines of text on caramel next to a left vertical panel of everyday women: the phrase to drop in white SERIF in quotes, the phrase to use below in larger white SCRIPT in quotes (3:48-4:06, 5:12-5:24). The bad reaction is acted out by a stock clip once (4:37 'Oh my gosh, stop'). The good reply 'Thank you. That's so kind.' is NOT shown as text (4:49-4:52).

GUIDE MENTIONS (Q8): three. (1) 0:46-0:57 'the full personal stylist guide is linked below' - no guide text (the episode title is still on screen until 0:51.9). (2) 4:26-4:31 'we go deeper into inside the Classy Academy guides' - darkened full clip with 'Check The Description' + 'Personal Stylist Guide' script, then fade to white into the next card. (3) 8:19-8:31 'check the description below for links and access to the personal stylist guide' - darkened clip + QR code top-right + URL www.classyladyacademy.com, then the same text on caramel. Comment ask 8:09-8:19 'Comment the number of the micro-habit you're committing to this week. I read them...' - no text, no graphic. No subscribe/like ask anywhere.

ENDING (Q9): last 30 s = 8:16 film man, 8:17.5 Audrey Hepburn hat, 8:19.6 film man, 8:22 cream-dress woman + convertible with QR/guide text, 8:29.5 caramel + guide text, 8:32 empty caramel ('Bye, my loves.' ends at 8:33.9), 8:34 dissolve to beige with logo, 8:34.7-8:46.3 white end card with tan CA logo (11.5 s, the space YouTube end-screen elements sit on). Music: per-second level jumps to about -17 dB on the end card (8:35-8:37, louder than any speech second), then -29 (8:38), -54 (8:39) and digital silence from 8:40 to the end.

BACKGROUNDS: two made backgrounds alternate: a warm CARAMEL blurred gradient (rows, text quotes, splits) and a pale CREAM/off-white (single rounded insets, B&W inset). Inset video always has large rounded corners; vertical insets are centred at about 1/3 frame width; landscape insets sit under top text.

TRANSITIONS: inside sections the editor mostly uses cross-dissolves of 0.5-1.5 s, plus the reels' own hard cuts; every white card is entered and left with a 0.4-0.5 s fade to/from white. Text always writes on left to right (soft-edge wipe) - never pops on.

REUSE: the same few creator clips return across the video: flower/living-room creator (0:25, 2:15, 2:22, 7:25), hat-and-column woman (0:21, 4:44), car-vlog woman (0:10, 5:12), Amal Clooney stage (0:40, 3:22), Paltrow/Lopez roundtable (2:52, 7:16).

LITERAL MATCHING (Q10): pictures follow the words closely - perfume for 'scent' (1:04-1:41), fast-cut fidgety reel for 'moves quickly, fidgets' (1:47), calm walking for 'walks without hurrying' (1:54-2:01), listening scenes for 'hold eye contact' (2:29-2:45), a laughing woman waving 'stop' for 'Oh my gosh, stop' (4:37), tidying a coffee table for 'tidy your space' (7:25), a woman on a bookstall walk for 'go for a walk' (7:30).

DIVERSITY: across the video the women range from 20s to 60s+ (older women at 2:02, 2:13, 4:37), several Black women (0:17, 1:16, 1:34, 2:05, 2:36, 2:47, 7:20), East/South-East Asian women (0:35, 1:54, 3:10, 3:27), a plus-size woman (6:11). Men appear only as partners in scenes (2:29, 2:41, 3:06, 4:53, 4:58, 8:16).
VOICE: one calm female voice-over throughout, no on-camera host; nothing is ever said by the people in the clips (all clip audio is replaced).
